# MOAA plugin list

Every plugin in the `moaa` marketplace. Install any of them with `/plugin install <name>@moaa`; the third-party ones are pinned to tested commits.

<!-- PLUGIN-LIST:START (generated by scripts/sync_catalog.py) -->

**103 plugins**: 12 MOAA plugins and 91 third-party plugins pinned to tested commits. Install any of them with `/plugin install <name>@moaa`.
